topics.label: Lecture introduction and framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic, context, and structural roadmap before substantive material begins.

topics.label: Fundamentals and core activation of the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the overall structure, naming conventions, and central pivotal role of component C3 cleavage in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the mechanisms of the alternative, lectin, and classical pathways that initiate complement and converge on the activation threshold.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream processes through which activated complement mediates opsonization, inflammation, and direct pathogen lysis.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the regulatory proteins and mechanisms that protect host cells from unintended complement-mediated damage.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the specific pathological presentations and disease phenotypes associated with deficiencies in various complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the evolutionary strategies and mechanisms pathogens employ to resist complement-mediated destruction, focusing on Staphylococcus aureus.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next steps
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks, wrap-up, and a preview of the next lecture topic.
